repos.name: paradigmxyz/iron-proxy
repos.description: An egress firewall for untrusted workloads.
repos.one_liner: A specialized egress firewall designed to secure untrusted workloads by controlling outbound network traffic.
bullets: Built in Go, focusing on high-performance network filtering and security.
Acts as a gatekeeper for sensitive environments, preventing unauthorized data exfiltration.
Ideal for infrastructure teams managing multi-tenant environments or untrusted AI agent execution.
Provides granular control over egress traffic, essential for zero-trust architecture.

repos.name: liguobao/ds-harness-remote
repos.description: 一个基于 DeepSeek Harness 插件机制构建的多端远程访问方案，通过安全、低延迟、端到端加密的 P2P 优先网络，支持从 PC、Android 和 Web 随时访问并操作远程 Harness 和 CodeX。 (A multi-device remote access solution built on the DeepSeek Harness plugin system, enabling PC, Android, and Web clients to securely access and operate remote Harness and CodeX over a low-latency, end-to-end encrypted, P2P-first network.)
repos.one_liner: A P2P-based remote access solution for DeepSeek Harness, enabling secure, low-latency control of AI development environments.
bullets: Utilizes P2P-first networking with end-to-end encryption for secure remote connectivity.
Integrates directly with the DeepSeek Harness plugin system for seamless AI workflow management.
Supports cross-platform access from PC, Android, and Web browsers.
Enables developers to manage and operate remote AI agents and CodeX instances on the go.

repos.name: Acelogic/Snapintosh
repos.description: EL2 hypervisor and toolchain that boots macOS on the ASUS A16 (Snapdragon X2 Elite), with an Adreno Metal/IOGPU stack
repos.one_liner: An EL2 hypervisor and toolchain enabling macOS execution on Snapdragon X Elite hardware.
bullets: Features a custom EL2 hypervisor and an Adreno Metal/IOGPU graphics stack.
Bridges the gap between ARM-based Windows hardware and macOS virtualization.
Provides a unique infrastructure platform for testing cross-platform ARM software.
Demonstrates advanced low-level systems engineering for modern heterogeneous computing.

repos.name: lemomo-ai/lemo-opuscar
repos.description: Claude Code skill for short films with no video model: 43 film styles, each a style prompt plus a demo film made entirely in code by Claude Opus 5.5 (incl. OPUSCAR 98). By Lemomo. · Opus5.5 x 43 种影片风格：风格提示词 + 纯代码样片 + 导演与技术指南
repos.one_liner: A collection of Claude Code skills that generate cinematic film styles through programmatic prompts.
bullets: Leverages Claude Opus 5.5 to translate code-based logic into high-quality visual styles.
Includes 43 distinct film style presets for automated creative content generation.
Demonstrates the power of agentic workflows in automating complex creative tasks.
Useful for rapid prototyping of media assets within AI-driven development pipelines.

repos.name: fastapi/fastapi
repos.description: FastAPI framework, high performance, easy to learn, fast to code, ready for production
repos.one_liner: A modern, high-performance web framework for building APIs with Python based on standard type hints.
bullets: Built on Starlette and Pydantic, offering industry-leading performance and asynchronous support.
Automatically generates OpenAPI documentation, critical for fintech and data-heavy API integrations.
Standardizes request validation and serialization, reducing bugs in production financial services.
Widely adopted as the backbone for modern AI/ML model serving and microservices infrastructure.
